rows.label: Funding
rows.text: Cash is below your minimum on 20 days. FLOW's committed plan covers the ¥405,000.00 shortfall for ¥3,113.93.

en.label: Buyer pays 30 days late
en.assumption_text: If Foshan Home Retail Co. paid every invoice 30 days late (a test, not a forecast). Buyer early-payment offer is taken out: it needs Foshan Home Retail Co.'s agreement. ¥420,000.00 from 1 invoice moves past the 120-day horizon. FLOW assumes none of these invoices can be financed; that understates what could be financed by at most ¥1,344,000.00.

en.assumption_text: Scenario assumes Foshan stops buying from you after today; the ¥420,000 already invoiced (due in 32 days) is still paid. This is not a prediction.

rows.text: 低于您的最低现金储备 20 天

rows.label: 融资
rows.text: 现金有 20 天低于您的最低现金。 FLOW 已承诺的方案能以 ¥3,113.93 覆盖 ¥405,000.00 的缺口。

zh.label: 买方晚付 30 天
zh.assumption_text: 如果 Foshan Home Retail Co. 的每张发票都晚付 30 天（这是压力测试，不是预测）。 已去掉Buyer early-payment offer：它需要 Foshan Home Retail Co. 同意。 1 张发票的 ¥420,000.00 移到了 120 天预测期之后。 FLOW 假设这些发票都无法融资；这最多会低估可融资的金额 ¥1,344,000.00。

rows.label: 按对方要求

zh.assumption_text: 本情景假设Foshan Home Retail Co.从今天以后不再向您采购；已开票的 ¥420,000（32 天后到期）仍会照付。这不是预测。
